competing_hypotheses.claim: Global USDC circulation contraction may coincide with reduced dollar liquidity or risk appetite and could correlate with XRP market depth.
disconfirming_or_missing: No XRPL-only USDC supply or redemption route data in this snapshot.
No matched historical XRP returns, market depth or control assets were tested.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconstruct daily USDC supply by chain and issuer, XRP order-book depth and cross-asset returns; test lagged relationships controlling for BTC, rates, USD and market-wide crypto flows.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The reported November 2 USD 530,000 outflow may be immaterial noise relative to cumulative inflows rather than a regime change.
disconfirming_or_missing: Other tracker universes report different dates and units; issuer-level complete files not reconciled.
competing_hypotheses.test: Rebuild daily XRP-unit holdings from every issuer file on a common fund universe and calculate rolling net flows, AUM-adjusted flows and persistence.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Perpetual open interest and positive funding may amplify short-term volatility but do not independently establish a bullish forecast.
disconfirming_or_missing: No same-cutoff spot depth, options skew, liquidation ladder or exchange-native position data in this observation.
competing_hypotheses.test: Join exchange-native OI, funding, basis, liquidations and spot depth at synchronized intervals; test volatility and direction separately.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Differences in ETF flow and derivatives OI totals may be driven primarily by incompatible fund/contract universes and timestamps rather than bad arithmetic.
disconfirming_or_missing: No common raw constituent dataset has been assembled to test this explanation.
competing_hypotheses.test: Normalize provider constituents, identifiers, contract multipliers, fund coverage and timestamps; compare only matched intersections and preserve unmatched residuals.
